name: Hash uses dynamic == and hash, not identity

input.source_text: class Key { public property id: Integer = 0 public fun ==(other: Object) -> Bool { @id == other.id() } public fun hash() -> Integer { @id } public fun id() -> Integer { @id } } module M { public fun run() -> Array { mut first = Key.new(); mut second = Key.new(); mut h = %{}; h[first] = 1; h[second] = 2; [h.fetch(first), h.delete(second)] } } M.run()
